tools.name: costa_list_services
tools.description: List published, reviewed Costa Contable services in Spanish or English.

tools.name: costa_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search published and reviewed Costa Contable guides and corridors. Returns source and review metadata; educational information only.

tools.name: costa_compare_entities
tools.description: Return reviewed educational comparison data for S.A., S. de R.L. and SAS when available; does not determine eligibility or recommend an entity.

tools.name: costa_group_preparation_checklist
tools.description: Return reviewed general preparation checklist for an international group considering Mexico operations. Not legal or tax advice.

tools.name: costa_create_contact_request
tools.description: Send a private contact request to Costa Contable and notify its team. Call only after the user explicitly asks to contact Costa and consents to follow-up and sharing these fields. Show the user the message and https://costacontable.com/privacy/ before submission. Do not include sensitive documents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: costa_search_knowledge · Private data: costa_create_contact_request · Public sink: costa_create_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: costa_search_knowledge · Private data: costa_create_contact_request · Public sink: costa_create_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
